notes: Copy to eval/golden_set.json and replace every REPLACE_WITH_DOCUMENT_ID.
GET /documents lists indexed documents with their ids.
Lab 4 asks for ~50 queries. Keep all five categories represented:
exact_id     - identifiers, codes, clause numbers. BM25 should win.
terminology  - domain jargon used verbatim. BM25 usually wins.
paraphrase   - user words differ from the document's. Dense/rewrite win.
permission   - the same question under a metadata filter.
expected_document_ids: every document that would satisfy the question.
filters: optional, passed straight to the retriever (source, tags, metadata).

queries.query: What does clause 7.3 of the data retention policy require?
how many days off do I get each year?
